name: excel_mcp
description: High-performance Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet automation and generation.
long_description: Excel MCP provides token-optimized tools to create, edit, format, inspect, and analyze Excel spreadsheets. Features single-pass workbook building (saving >90% tokens), visual design presets (corporate, financial, modern, compact), lightweight outline inspection, formula automation, and native chart generation.

tools.name: excel_build_workbook
tools.description: Build a complete Excel workbook with typography, zebra striping, currency/date formats, formulas, and charts in a single pass.

tools.name: excel_get_workbook_outline
tools.description: Inspect structural outline of an Excel workbook without dumping massive cell grids into LLM context.

tools.name: excel_batch_write_data
tools.description: Write a 2D matrix of values or formulas into a worksheet starting from a specific cell in one atomic operation.

tools.name: excel_append_rows
tools.description: Append batch rows of data below the existing content in a worksheet in an atomic operation.

tools.name: excel_create_workbook
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_create_worksheet
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_list_documents
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_read_data
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_write_data
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_format_range
tools.description: Apply a wide range of visual and data formatting styles to a specified cell range in an Excel worksheet.

tools.name: excel_format_sheet
tools.description: Configure worksheet-level display settings and layout properties.

tools.name: excel_create_table
tools.description: Convert a range of cells into a native, styled Excel Table.

tools.name: excel_sort_range
tools.description: Sort a 2D range of cells in-place by a specific key column.

tools.name: excel_insert_rows_columns
tools.description: Insert empty rows or columns at the specified 1-based index in a worksheet.

tools.name: excel_delete_rows_columns
tools.description: Delete rows or columns starting at the specified 1-based index in a worksheet.

tools.name: excel_copy_worksheet
tools.description: Create a duplicate of an existing worksheet within the same Excel workbook.

tools.name: excel_delete_worksheet
tools.description: Permanently delete a worksheet from a workbook.

tools.name: excel_rename_worksheet
tools.description: Change the name of an existing worksheet within a workbook.

tools.name: excel_get_workbook_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about an Excel workbook, including a list of all worksheets and optional details about named ranges.

tools.name: excel_merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a rectangular range of cells into a single, larger cell.

tools.name: excel_unmerge_cells
tools.description: Unmerge a previously merged cell range, reverting it to individual cells.

tools.name: excel_copy_range
tools.description: Copy a range of cells, including their values and formatting, to a new location, potentially in a different worksheet.

tools.name: excel_delete_range
tools.description: Delete a range of cells and optionally shift the surrounding cells to fill the gap.

tools.name: excel_validate_range
tools.description: Validate that a given cell range is valid within a specific worksheet.

tools.name: excel_validate_formula_syntax
tools.description: Validate the syntax of an Excel formula without writing it to a cell.

tools.name: excel_apply_formula
tools.description: Excel workbook operation.

tools.name: excel_create_chart
tools.description: Create a chart in a worksheet based on a specified data range.

tools.name: excel_create_pivot_table
tools.description: Create a pivot table in a worksheet to summarize and analyze data from a given range.

tools.name: excel_find_cells
tools.description: Search for cells containing text or regular expression patterns across sheets.

tools.name: excel_profile_sheet
tools.description: Generate lightweight column-level profiling and statistical summaries for a worksheet.

tools.name: excel_add_data_validation
tools.description: Add a data validation rule to a worksheet range.

tools.name: excel_protect_sheet
tools.description: Protect or unprotect a worksheet, with optional per-action exceptions.

tools.name: excel_configure_page_setup
tools.description: Configure the print layout of a worksheet.
